About La-Tigra
Meet Our Projects
Meet Our Team
At La Tigra Rainforest Lodge, our story is woven with a passion for environ- mental protection and a deep love for nature, creating an unparalleled haven for those seeking lodging near La Fortuna. Located just a few miles outside the charming town of La Tigra, San Carlos, and a scenic 30-minute drive from the renowned Arenal Volcano and La Fortuna Town, we offer an oasis where your stay becomes an eco-conscious adventure.
Our lodge stands apart with a unique concept —ten tent cabins gracefully perched on raised platforms, nestled within the enchanting tropical rainfo- rest on the fringes of the celebrated Children s Eternal Rainforest, Central America s largest private reserve.
Beyond the conventional, we are a sanctuary of environmental conserva-tion, where each guest becomes a steward of nature, understanding the significance of conservation efforts.
Our Commitment Extends
Further
Reaching out to the San Jorge de la Roca Elementary School, situated next to our property. We not only provide job opportunities for the community but also practice sustainable construction — all wood and materials harves-ted through a meticulously planned, controlled felling on our property spanning over two decades.
More than just a charming place to stay, we are a tapestry of purpose and commitment. La Tigra Rainforest Lodge provides the idyllic setting to enjoy your vacation, connecting with nature amidst the tropical rainforest.
Mission
To offer each client a direct contact with nature, in a tranquil,
relaxing environment with privacy, comfort, and personalized
service.
Vision
To be a model lodging service, promoting conservation,
rational use of the natural resources, and environmental
education.

Planning a trip to Costa Rica and specifically to La Tigra Lodge is an exciting adventure. As you prepare for your travel to Costa Rica, you might be wondering exactly what you need to pack. This comprehensive guide will walk you through everything you should bring to make your stay at La Tigra Lodge comfortable and enjoyable. Whether it s your first time experiencing the lush beauty of Costa Rica or you’re a seasoned traveler, packing right is essential for a hassle-free vacation.
Understanding the Climate and Environment
La Tigra Lodge is located near La Fortuna and the majestic Arenal Volcano, in a region known for its tropical rainforest climate. This means warm temperatures, high humidity, and a fair amount of rain throughout the year. Packing appropriately for these conditions will ensure you stay comfortable and ready for any adventure.
Clothing Essentials for La Tigra Lodge
When packing for your travel to Costa Rica, consider the following clothing items:
T-shirts and Tank Tops : Opt for moisture-wicking materials.
Long-Sleeved Shirts : These are great for both sun protection and cooler evenings.
Shorts and Lightweight Pants : Quick-dry materials are ideal.
Lightweight, Breathable Fabrics
Rain Gear
Rain Jacket or Poncho : A must-have due to frequent showers.
Waterproof Backpack Cover : To keep your belongings dry.
Hiking Boots or Sturdy Sneakers : Essential for exploring trails.
Sandals : Comfortable for casual walks around the lodge.
Water Shoes : Great for any water-related activities or wet terrain.
Footwear
Accessories
Sun Hat and Sunglasses : For sun protection.
Swimsuits : Perfect for hot springs and swimming.
Light Scarf or Bandana : Useful for multiple purposes, including sun and bug protection.
Tech and Gadgets
Phone and Charger : Don’t forget a portable power bank.
Flashlight or Headlamp : Useful for nighttime walks or power outages.
FAQs about Traveling to La Tigra Lodge
Here are some common questions travelers have when planning their trip:
What type of plug adapter do I need for Costa Rica?
Costa Rica uses Type A and Type B plugs, the same as the USA. Voltage is 120V, so travelers from countries with different voltage systems will need a converter.
Is it safe to drink tap water at La Tigra Lodge?
Check with your healthcare provider, but common recommendations include Hepatitis A and Typhoid. A Yellow Fever vaccine is required if you’re coming from a country with risk of Yellow Fever.
What kind of activities can I do near La Tigra Lodge?
Popular activities include hiking, bird watching, visiting the Arenal Volcano, exploring La Fortuna, and enjoying hot springs.
How can I stay connected while at La Tigra Lodge?
Lodges offer Wi-Fi at the reception an restaurant area, but connectivity might be limited in remote areas. Consider purchasing a local SIM card for better coverage.
Travel to Costa Rica and specifically to La Tigra Lodge offers an unforgettable experience. By packing appropriately for the climate and planned activities, you can ensure a comfortable and enjoyable trip. Remember to bring lightweight clothing, rain gear, sturdy footwear, essential personal items, and health and safety supplies. With the right preparation, you’re all set for an amazing adventure in one of the most beautiful destinations in the world.
Embark on your journey well-prepared and savor every moment of your vacation in Costa Rica, from the lush rainforests to the stunning wildlife and beyond. Safe travels!
